Friend – **my roots are planted deeply in Georgia soil.**

I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah – and I attended Morehouse College, a historically Black university in Atlanta. I went on what I called a "full faith" scholarship, meaning I didn't know how I would pay for my first full semester.
But through hard work and the support of my community, I was the first in my family to graduate from college – and then became the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the spiritual home of Martin Luther King Jr.

I know firsthand how attending an HBCU prepared me for a life of service – and I'm fighting tooth and nail in the Senate to make sure every kid has the opportunity to achieve their American dream.
**But this is going to be an uphill battle: Experts at _NPR_ confirm that I'm the _most vulnerable_ Senate Democrat up for reelection, and recent polls show me 2 points down. I urgently need your grassroots support to pull ahead and win: [_Please, will you pitch in $5 or more now to keep Georgia blue and defend our Senate majority – so I can keep giving all folks a voice in our government?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51341308/369048769/-1789705490?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3972-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDgzOTA5Zi0zZjNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cuyZFB7YKdUwrtiYGj0wHEBBs8AVgwA1rGNdmLwynTA=)**
Thank you, friend. With your help, I know we can win.
– Rev. Raphael Warnock

Democrats aren't scared of the looming midterm
elections....they're just getting started.

Peter,
With the end of the quarter approaching, we
must stand together and show the Democrats we've had enough of
their radical, American Last policies.
Despite Democrats claiming the border is
secure -- and freaking out over a few dozen migrants being
dropped off in wealthy, woke Martha's Vineyard -- the border is
wide open.
In fact, 78 people on the terrorist watch
list have been caught trying to enter the United States and the
Democrats are doing nothing about it!
Despite the Democrats stating that our
economy experienced zero inflation last month, we still have
record high inflation rates. And yet Democrats want to increase
spending levels and create an endless number of new Marxist
programs.
Democrats aren't scared of the looming
midterm elections....they're just getting started.
It's imperative we finish out the quarter
strong, fight back, and win in November. Will you donate $25,

Right now, Democrats think they can get away
with their insane policies. We must show them we are all
committed to their defeat.
We're only a few days away from the end of
the quarter. I must hit my fundraising goal by 11:59 pm on
September 30.
Biden, Pelosi, and the radical Left need to
see freedom-loving Americans voicing their disappointment and
opposition to their destructive policies. The best way for you to

I'm only $36,812.55 away from my target.
If Republicans don't take back the House this

Instead, we'll be watching Biden and his

Please chip in whatever you can afford to

There's too much at stake to sit on the

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397739:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397740:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397741:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397742:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397743:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397744:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397745:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397746:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397738:J8MdtPVNS:m:1:3317145305:01A66DEE7D573A107730FC8B43A7CA36:r)

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation</

subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397705:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397710:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397711:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397712:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61397704:JLgxtPVNV:m:1:3331421248:7814C3A087C84B61F6981FC2273259ED:r)

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
President

BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Peter. After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also the GOP Nominee in the MUST WIN race in NC-14, a brand-new district that WILL decide who controls Washington. **

Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden already have $100 million bucks ready to trash our GOP candidates in every swing district on the map.

The talking heads and political know-it-alls say I can't win this race. But I bet you've heard that one before...

I'm not the kind of guy who asks for help, but starting a grassroots campaign is tough - **really, really tough. **

The Democrats won't stop attacking us and cutting off every path to victory we have. Folks like you & me - they hate our guts.

Please have my back on this one:

subject: This is not about me, Peter...
body:
Let's lay politics aside for a moment.

| | | | Good morning Peter,

This is not a political email, but is is a very important email, so **please read through to the end**...

I'm reaching out to you this morning to let you know about a dear friend of mine, Peyton White, who is both an **autistic adult** and **the founder** of the **Team Awesomism Virtual Academy** headquartered in The Woodlands, TX.

Peyton started the Team Awesomism Virtual Academy because unfortunately, there is a lack of programs for autistic adults and many are being left behind. The CDC estimates there are over 5,437,988 (2.21%) autistic adults, with some “experts” putting that number around 8-9 million.

Through the Virtual Academy, Peyton is helping other autistic adults learn life skills, social skills, soft skills, be part of a loving community, and overall giving them a purpose in life when they've been forgotten by many.

**But Peyton needs _our_ help!**

You see, Peyton's heart is to keep the Team Awesomism Virtual Academy **free** for all autistic adults.

But how can he do this and still afford to run the academy?

That is where **you** and **I** come in, Peter.

And between now and Friday, 9/30/22, Peyton is offering Awesomism Teammates, which is an exclusive membership that includes a 4 for 40 giveaway.

**Here's how it works...**

When you become an Awesomism Teammate for $40, you will get 4 entries into a giveaway that is valued at over $400. Additionally, you will be invited to 4 exclusive online events that will include other giveaways and VIP prizes. You will also receive exclusive access to a newsletter that will have all kinds of insider information, freebies, and opportunities to connect with others within the autism community.

This will not be made available to the public, only to Awesomism Teammates who register before midnight on Friday, September 30, 2022.

And before you ask...

YES, I am an Awesomism Teammate, myself.

I am not a hypocrite and would never ask you to do anything that I wasn't willing to do myself.

So I unapologetically ask you to join me in supporting Peyton in his mission to turn Autism into Awesomism.

And if you do, I'll also add you into a drawing for my newest campaign T-Shirt, absolutely free. Simply reply to this email and attach a screenshot of your receipt as proof of your purchase as an Awesomism Teammate.

[Click here and become an Awesomism Teammate today](https://jamesonellis.lt.acemlna.com/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZjaGVja291dC5zcXVhcmUuc2l0ZSUyRm1lcmNoYW50JTJGTUxLRkRDTjAwUERRMCUyRmNoZWNrb3V0JTJGNFY3Q0k1VTVKWTNEVEVSSEc2N01UT1dE&sig=FdG1UeYFWYxYxkt4RFeha7uJaBFxDWdoyt1ioTeMVBUQ&iat=1664197272&a=%7C%7C611311006%7C%7C&account=jamesonellis%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=8RRDsQMegL%2Bk1g7KlTCN33wFoqDlMHNmyq65fGLdufk%3D&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&i=94A114A1A697).

body:

| | Peter, Are there any sane Democrats left who will call out Joe Biden for his insults? He is calling every conservative American a "semi-fascist." He's threatening to use the might of the federal government to murder Republicans. And not one member of the political establishment - including my opponent - will stand up to him. They always agree with everything Joe Biden says because everything he does keeps THEM in power. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH. It's time to fight back and make the government work FOR THE PEOPLE. Not against us!**__**_[**Are you with me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)_**_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)
---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me...there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)

[ ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400650:JqeBgPVJN:m:1:3345639852:CDE7CBDA6FD3098D9C1DE5DD1BAF5CA5:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "I went on to play
soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Scotty was
severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s
first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "In 2007, we
welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404775:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404776:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404776:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404776:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404777:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404778:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for
your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61404778:6mgOgPVNm:m:1:3331421248:EE95DA98379392960A57C5E31FAD0E6E:r "Step up now!")**_

---

Team – Are you seeing this?

So I'm hoping I can count on you to help us out.
There are two ways to go about this:

I understand that not everyone will be able to donate today. But however you decide to help, whether it is donating for someone who can't, volunteering, or just simply staying updated on the state of this race, I really appreciate it.

Thank you in advance.

As I waited for the traffic light to turn green, crowds of obvious out-of- towners appeared. They were making their way along the sidewalks towards the mall, that long, rectangle of grass and gravel central to the Capitol, the Washington Monument, and the Smithsonian museums. I saw young parents with little ones in strollers, I saw the same elderly couples I have seen in countless neighborhoods from countless American towns and suburbs. I watched them with realization: these were the people who had come from all over the country to support President Trump on the day set aside for Congress to count the electoral votes of the recent presidential elections. They had come to voice their concerns over the legitimacy of the results. They had come to exercise their right...their duty as American citizens. Mark Houck is the founder and president of “King’s Men” which promotes healing for victims of pornography addiction and Christian values in men throughout the United States and U.K. The Department of Justice sent a SWAT team to Houck’s home, guns drawn, with his wife and seven children in the house. Houck was accused of a supposed “FACE Act” violation which implies that he interfered with entry into an abortion clinic. The facts are that he defended his 12-year-old son after the victim got into the child’s personal space, shouting obscurities and vulgar words. subject: Another Congressman steps up for Erik Aadland
body:

---
|
# Congressman Ken Buck Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from United States Representative, Ken Buck.

In 2004, Ken Buck was elected Weld County District Attorney and was subsequently re-elected twice more. After a successful legal career in Weld County, Buck is currently serving his fourth term in the United States House of Representatives, representing Colorado Congressional District 4. name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: I am inviting you to join our cause.
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Peter, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400413:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400414:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400415:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400416:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400417:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400418:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400419:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400420:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61400412:JcKpTfVhN:m:1:3334294963:C69438C865C57BF1AFDDE936F85A099C:r)

Thank you, Peter.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation</

We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I 'll share my story... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I've dealt with racism... I 've even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Peter, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Peter. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation</ This message was intended for: mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com You were added to the system August 9, 2022. subject: I don't want this to be sayonara

body:
We're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)
---
Peter,

Time is flying by and we're getting dangerously close to the fundraising deadline that will determine the future of my race. The RNC in DC is watching my race closely; **if my campaign can reach the goal they set for us, they'll invest in my district.**

Today marks 43 days until Election Day and 4 days until the end of the 3rd quarter, meaning that as of this writing, **[I've only 4 days to meet their goal, or it's sayonara.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)** In case you missed it , I'm forwarding my original message from last week.

**[I'd be so appreciative if you were able to gift my campaign a couple dollars to help us reach this make-or-break fundraising goal](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)**.

| [**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)
---

\-----Forwarded message-----
From: Alek Skarlatos - info@alekskarlatosforcongress.com
Date: Fri Sept 16 2022
Subject: I've been given an ultimatum
To: {{email}}

{{#if [FirstName]}}{{[FirstName]}}{{else}}Fellow Conservative{{/if}},

They just keep moving the ball on me; I feel like I can't get a break, and to be honest with you it's exhausting. The Republican Party big-wigs in D.C. keep hedging their bets and won't commit to sending me help because they're somehow still not sure that I'm worth the investment.

Instead of putting money into my race, they're spending millions on seats we can't win. But, as a former national guardsman, I know how to play by the rules and take orders; here is hoping you can help me meet the requirements they've set in order to barnstorm the state with money to help me secure victory.

**National Republicans want me to raise $100,000 by the end of the quarter (September 30th), and they'll make an investment in my race; if i can't, I'll be on my own till the end.**

With only 14 days to go, we're still short about $60,000. **[If you're in a position to give, would you make a generous contribution to my campaign today?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)**

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)
---

Whether it's a test or not - I'm not taking any chances. While Oregon's 4th district has been held by the same career politician since 1986, it's ripe for the picking now that he is finally retiring.
**
[If you're on the fence about donating to my campaign, remember this race has national implications. The outcome of my race could well determine which party controls the House next year. ](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r) **

My opponent this year is a the protegée of my opponent from 2020, meaning she supports the Green New Deal, and would most certainly join the House Progressive Caucus.

Republicans came within 554 votes in 2016 from flipping OR-4 from BLUE to RED. Please help me finish the job this time around. If I'm able to secure a sizeable investment from Republicans in D.C., I know we can overcome the barriers that kept us from winning this race two years ago.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)
---

I know that you have a lot of political candidates asking for you to make contributions to their campaign, but I'd like you to ask yourself this: how many races could realistically determine whether or not Nancy Pelosi loses the speaker's gavel next Congress? Less than 10.

[**GIFT A COUPLE BUCKS** **› › **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)
---

Thanks for your consideration, {{#if [FirstName]}}{{[FirstName]}}{{else}}Fellow Conservative{{/if}}

In service,
[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60828291:szCnXahLN:m:1:2237666910:28E934E17794CB50D05608981759CFE6:r)
Alek Skarlatos
Republican for Congress

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3ef796f488b545cdbe62c1e64371c5f6&_e=w-Ir-9QxKHb29MpdItECdpumP0lVsTIIK0Q3CwbuDLECfbhzGckgcMWwCrYvd4JXtv5Yk9tXOUOJbXjJdDCqP9LNZ49dSaApEwiCHr57ViQUTA2-Lq290Y9VQ8GQBJbDND0UfvGIaiokSdCwCYFr5xHDevEsD9FqmD7IvWHiLDsg4D86QVIvdC6FuXCRRsisWR3uW3D4zvUHtfq4xXtw1lPf0kSFvzNwpTQ6kWPfk_-lPb5kLcLZjcLwF8GPbJC888gAF0XTIMMO9H3o6DI51dUzeEkXP2TJCTx1EYC5h6UxksnNoBXrd0oln9NPPHOvLp6fHsokPe2McV8-LwzhmDpl26TluOg3NRcWmq9J8ZVpWvrhBkKUIjsF2qjSFHFpm2E_DfUQjVyWL8mcrfQE48pHcBXyFA7oA6OJ_5TTi7A%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=3ef796f488b545cdbe62c1e64371c5f6&_e=w-Ir-9QxKHb29MpdItECdpumP0lVsTIIK0Q3CwbuDLECfbhzGckgcMWwCrYvd4JXtv5Yk9tXOUOJbXjJdDCqP9LNZ49dSaApEwiCHr57ViQUTA2-Lq290Y9VQ8GQBJbDND0UfvGIaiokSdCwCYFr5xHDevEsD9FqmD7IvWHiLDsg4D86QVIvdC6FuXCRRsisWR3uW3D4zvUHtfq4xXtw1lPf0kSFvzNwpTQ6kWPfk_-lPb5kLcLZjcLwF8GPbJC8rbrtabtlHZagRKfHo0htDHInjrctuTgG7y_b4bQh5UWulezFtyjZdGx0HwcCEFkHf-paG69eRsDCSPsw0xhyb68mw7ielAIhFz64oo_gn7GzvJ6RuNNIbE3ZMrhC40BLFDiXjKGBaywIHc2r0GZZBc65FE7jSa_C5c-Me2gF09U%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friends, my team just sent me two huge red flags.
1. My Republican opponent **Kevin Kiley just purchased TV ad time**.

2. Trump just launched “**MAGA, Inc.** ” — a super PAC to direct millions towards his endorsed candidates — including Kiley.

subject: the cost of Eric Schmitt's vote
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
For just a few expensive dinners, Eric Schmitt has sold out Missouri families time and time again.
| | |
---
Peter, right now, families are spending a lot of time thinking about prices. Gas, groceries, keeping the lights on – the price of just about everything keeps on rising.
But my opponent, Eric Schmitt, doesn't care about rising prices. The only price on his mind is how much the next lobbyist will give him to vote their way – regardless of what it costs his constituents.
**You see, Eric Schmitt's vote has always been for sale.** He's taken more than $10,000 in gifts from lobbyists and campaign contributions from special interests – and they got what they paid for.
They bought his vote to protect Big Pharma profit margins. They bought his lawsuit to let health insurance companies charge Missouri women and seniors more for health care. And they bought his votes to sell Missouri farmland to a Chinese company. **For just a few expensive dinners, an exclusive golf trip, a couple tickets to the big game, or even a Christmas ham, Eric Schmitt has sold out Missouri families time and time again.**
**And now, he's running for Senate because he knows that he can charge even more for his vote in Washington.** For him, this is all about power and the money that comes with it. Missourians deserve better than that.
That's why I'm in this race. As a nurse and a children's advocate, I've spent my life serving my community. I'm running for Senate to continue that commitment to service and make life better for families back home – not make a buck at the expense of my home state. And I've released a plan to end the corruption and greed that's doing so much damage in Washington.
**You have my word on this: I will be no one's senator but yours – and my vote will _never_ be for sale. **
**But just like Eric Schmitt's vote, winning this race comes at a price.** I'll only defeat Schmitt and his far-right megadonors if grassroots supporters like you stand with my campaign.**[That's why I have to ask: Please, will you make a $5 donation to help me flip Missouri blue, defeat Eric Schmitt, and bring real integrity to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51363499/369128194/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk313-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MmNiMWFmNy1iNDNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CAnB6iPERzuzUVU7voeYA1iY8z7f8_6knl_NR5TlXAk=)**

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

Hi, this is Congresswoman Lucy McBath.

I’m reaching out today to ask for your help in making Jen Jordan the next Attorney General of Georgia. [**Polls have her race statistically tied, and every bit of support she can get in these last 43 days of the campaign will be critical. Can you make a contribution of $10 or more to help elect Jen?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51345719/369059175/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_220926LB_N_LB_FULL_9_NG_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNmUyODA5Zi05NzNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BD6jJQKesuZ-kMUjs1zfIcOUJfzcQDN5wl7zK_6DIz8=)

I got into politics through my advocacy for gun safety. As you may know, it's a very personal fight for me — my son, Jordan Davis, was shot and killed ten years ago.

The gun lobby has tried to stop the work of gun safety advocates at every turn. We've made progress, but it hasn't been easy. **It would be a lot easier if we didn't have politicians in office who cared more about appeasing the gun lobby than protecting the lives of their constituents.**

Jen has proven time and time again that she's not afraid of groups like the NRA. She's sponsored legislation to keep guns away from domestic abusers, she's championed background checks, and she recently was a strong opponent of Georgia's new permitless carry legislation.

Meanwhile, her opponent — and current Attorney General — Chris Carr has done everything he can to cozy up to the gun lobby. He publicly urged the Supreme Court to strike down laws that limit magazine capacities. He sided with the NRA when it faced a lawsuit over allegations of fraud and corruption. And he proudly takes max-out contributions from the gun lobby.

It's time Georgians had better leadership, and they need an advocate like Jen to deliver it. She has the convictions and credentials needed to keep our families safe from gun violence. I'm proud to stand with her in this race, and I know she'll keep fighting tooth and nail for Georgians.

**I've won multiple hard-fought races, and I can tell you just how important it is to have the resources for ads, field organizing, and digital outreach in the final stretch before Election Day. Jen's race is coming down to the wire, and we need to leave it all on the field for her.**

We've made progress, but it hasn't been easy. It would be a lot easier if we didn't have politicians in office who cared more about appeasing the gun lobby than protecting the lives of their constituents. Jen has proven time and time again that she's not afraid of groups like the NRA. She's sponsored legislation to keep guns away from domestic abusers, she's championed background checks, and she recently was a strong opponent of Georgia's new permitless carry legislation. Meanwhile, her opponent — and current Attorney General — Chris Carr has done everything he can to cozy up to the gun lobby. I’m a man of my word.

Each day I fight to protect the fundamental rights of all Americans.
In the Senate, I’m advocating for women’s reproductive rights, affordable healthcare, and better resources for our veterans.

Even before I was a Senator, I was a pastor advocating for my community, for voting rights, and for education.

**On the other hand, my opponent, Herschel Walker, has been rallying with Donald Trump and seen at megadonor fundraisers with Mitch McConnell. If he wins, everything we’ve been working towards could be lost.**
**So today, I’m reaching out to you. I’m running a 100% grassroots campaign. name: Barbara Boxer
subject: There’s too much at stake. I cannot sit on the sidelines.
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51366747/369140335/-707005773?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNGM3MmU5ZC1iYzNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qT7reVoTDhc6WEiPD9oLmqOVigM7T0rLTfHautcWW4o=)
This is infuriating, Peter.

This summer, we watched Trump’s radical Supreme Court strip away rights that belong to women and hand them to extremists in the states.

Then, we watched the same Republicans who cheered “states rights” introduce a **_national abortion ban_** that would put them in charge of a woman’s most personal decision.

I’ll be blunt. If we give these extremists another inch in the House or Senate, they'd have no issue sending us back into the dark ages.

Lives are at stake. Every woman -- and every person who loves a woman -- needs to vote out the Republicans who are aligning with this hypocritical crusade. Here in CA-41, that starts by ousting the incumbent Republican Ken Calvert.

**[Can I count on you to send in an urgent contribution to help pro-choice Democrat Will Rollins unseat Ken Calvert? Will’s team tells me they need to see 500 donations come in before midnight to stay on pace to meet their FEC goal, and $3 from you would go a long way.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51366762/369140343/192312732?refcode=em-9.26.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNGM3MmU5ZC1iYzNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qT7reVoTDhc6WEiPD9oLmqOVigM7T0rLTfHautcWW4o=)**

After 30 years in Congress, Ken Calvert has earned a 0% score from Planned Parenthood Action Fund. _Zero!_ He’s a staunch opponent of choice and backs extreme restrictions -- including in instances of rape. He voted for a bill to jail doctors that perform abortions. And he even voted against the bi-partisan Violence Against women Act!

His views on choice are radical and dangerous. They are why this election is so critical for anyone who cares about women's privacy and respect. Our community deserves a member of Congress like Will Rollins, who will fight for our freedoms and health.

body:
Law enforcement is investigating a death threat sent to US Congressional candidate Dr. Bob Lorinser. The campaign immediately reported the explicit assassination threat to local authorities, which successfully contacted the alleged perpetrator and began an investigation. Because of the specificity of the message, Lorinser also reported the threat to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). On Thurs. Sept. 22, the campaign received the following text message in reply to an event invitation in Elk Rapids:
**IMMEDIATE RELEASE** : Fri. Sept. 23, 2022
**CONTACT:**
* Bob Lorinser
* info@votedrbob.com
* +1 906-275-4487

**After assassination threat on Lorinser, police assure public safety**
ANTRIM COUNTY, Mich. — Law enforcement is investigating a death threat sent to US Congressional candidate Dr. Bob Lorinser. The campaign immediately reported the explicit assassination threat to local authorities, which successfully contacted the alleged perpetrator and began an investigation.
Because of the specificity of the message, Lorinser also reported the threat to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI).
On Thurs. Sept. 22, the campaign received the following text message in reply to an event invitation in Elk Rapids:
“I am going to assassinate Dr. Bob Lorinser during this event using a Remington .270 rifle from the rooftop of a nearby building, the moment he exits his vehicle.”
Details about the sender are not available.
"I want to thank law enforcement for responding," said Lorinser. "Authorities should always take these matters seriously to ensure the public's safety. I’m confident the police will handle the situation properly. Fortunately, this threat is not indicative of the warm reception we receive across the state. It isn’t who we are as Northern Michiganders. The campaign will fearlessly move forward.”
# # #
Dr. Bob Lorinser is running for US Congress in Michigan’s 1st Congressional District, covering Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula. The midterm election is on Tues. Nov. 8, 2022.

| Peter,

A Pima County judge lifted an injunction, reversing course on a century of precedent to allow a 121 year-old-law to go into effect that would virtually ban abortion in Arizona, criminalize the doctors who perform them, and provide no exceptions for instances of rape or incest.
