**I don't want to stop helping Ukraine, but[I need your support](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xE1YEhnwsC4rKwhxx2Bf-cf-kU0yYh1i1mQM88NRmV4WAvGcMLSRaS8Ly2-6n2BUll6aLIXlbixLaD_O81NDtUrIlXANPHRuJjcfVEk52fpN10okf-izbAzrzfr16fCxpuk03AyhlPkaujsI-SnK9iER7I031OBOxbiVEJhV-orKLF4KE8qhg1ok6f19CcxfmJpo6g7PzBNTmbk1Y2EK5McYvso-oqWNzXPv0iq0Ek-SsUL3Ftc8jUeNjM5bTb7dC47w2GMH58_DlZpYYJ-zqYMzG8OTtYRaOZLaa28c7vKQ/3ps/VoQIv7LsSlmGFGa-oWCTvQ/h3/wBSdHi0CrC9-TrKXWnL7ql_to0BDMUy-2L9c3NExaJk) as I'm spending most of my time these days on Ukraine -- it's practically my full-time job.** But before I ask for your help, let me share some of the people and groups I've helped with my fundraising along the way:
* We provided over $10,000 in direct aid to Ukrainian refugee families.
* We bought a bus, filled it with medicine, then used it to evacuate Ukrainian families from occupied-Mariupol.
* We provided tens of thousands of dollars to Ukrainian "meals on wheels" groups who deliver food to people in bomb shelters or shut-ins who can't leave their homes (e.g., the elderly).
* We purchased two cars for "meals on wheels" group Kharkovy Mir to help it ramp up its food deliveries.
* We bought and sent $10,000 in first aid kits to Ukraine.
* We provided several thousand dollars worth of food and medical supplies to people with disabilities in a front-line town.
* And we bought $1,000 worth of cookies to give refugee kids a long-missed treat.

That gives you a taste of what I've been doing these past seven months. [**If you agree my work is important, and would like to see it continue, please consider making a contribution to help me continue supporting Ukraine throughout the coming winter.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xE1YEhnwsC4rKwhxx2Bf-cf-kU0yYh1i1mQM88NRmV4WAvGcMLSRaS8Ly2-6n2BUmxvQqH8Hw2fSQuCKPfc5A8-nAJHh7p8iIyMoka7iAKSf1gmzirwYog6WaeWJMV588oR2Z8DpQgjJYaKaxmA7YwM35O096gqibrdp7px22j2Vdn5M_Dh9b16WrHEUgjvzx5M544ECJBycOGiXjMdmjiMjtYOjfJYgjdB0raBf30Ivk3AfMXNn7OpMyYla9c2R8bbRPx6G8-EOERhpkxXtXE4Tn9d7eQhjE2HzIwuDJScw/3ps/VoQIv7LsSlmGFGa-oWCTvQ/h4/IXue0fFVjme66kuzfJSa0_9gU56WhPpcUfAXdpblF_0) Thanks so much, JOHN

_Gabby and me during her recovery_
Friends —
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system around me to help me through.
Being raised by two working parents who sometimes struggled to make ends meet wasn’t always easy.
Flying combat missions in Desert Storm wasn’t easy.
Watching Gabby fight so hard in the early days, weeks, and months of her recovery wasn’t easy.
Running for the U.S. Senate and having Donald Trump and National Republicans relentlessly attack me personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my brother Scott.
In combat, I had my wingmen.
With Gabby, we had our whole community offering support.
And in these campaigns, I have you.
I could not do this without you. You probably didn't wake up this morning thinking you’d make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat my Republican opponent and hold this seat.

---
| | Friend, What is it with the establishment elites HIDING from the people? Joe Biden's been in the basement for months. He pops out - delivers a massively unpopular plan for student loan forgiveness - and goes back to avoiding the public. That peek-a-boo act must be written into the official Democrat playbook because my opponent, Katie Hobbs, is doing the exact same thing! She refuses to debate. She refuses to show her face to the people of Arizona. If she's not making a plea to the radical left for more Soros money to fund her campaign, no one hears from her at all. This unaccountable, ridiculous behavior is so typical of a political establishment that does not value the voice of the people. _[**FIGHT BACK >>**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zml86r69q00deqb21f74uuhjsa69d9fe9s66up4o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)_ Now, it should be clear by now... **I'm not hiding.** That’s because**I’M NOT AFRAID.** I speak with the people every day because I believe that WE THE PEOPLE deserve to hear from both sides and get a fair idea of who will stand for you and who won't. _The silence is deafening. _ While conservative leaders like me on the NEW RIGHT are open books... The failing establishment elites are closed doors.
It’s time for us to say OUT WITH THE OLD, and in with the NEW (RIGHT) so we can SAVE AMERICA from these out-of-touch narcissists. **__[Are you with me?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrpu034lbhbjh8qpjv0kbo1j88s88vr9t6886fq8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)_ _**
---

---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I’m the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0h1hlsktnvh1fqhuvq76sd5gaqgdke47ia8qt0o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)
---
Together, we’re going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me... there’s a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I’ve always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that’s not going to stop now!_
---
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgsv61k4l26j9hpu1ht5igtpkd0h44pa2sie8270_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)
---
I grew up in Iowa. There’s not a lot to do there, but that’s where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had — that’s what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that “BDE” that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me “Kari, you’re going to be the DeSantis of the West.” Other than being called “Trump in a Dress — which is my favorite compliment of all — that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you’re going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfmfdlrk7a3ahb6lk6o1ogej3ddvdk26sk4e41cg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)
---
**Friend, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden’s ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Friend, let’s not forget that the race for Governor of Arizona is one of the most important fights in the entire country.** ** It’s our chance to prove to corporate media that we are stronger than the lies. ** ** It’s our chance to prove to the establishment elite that the NEW RIGHT is here to stay.** ** And it’s our chance to SECURE OUR BORDER, defend our small businesses, defeat inflation, end leftist indoctrination and get our nation back on track.** ** Though the results took longer than they should have, Arizonans who have been forgotten by the establishment already delivered a POLITICAL EARTHQUAKE in the GOP primary. We won every single county in Arizona!** ** Now, all eyes are on us. ** ** It’s game time.** ** And I need you on my side.** ** **_[Will you support our momentum?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zdd417g016rdvhl1e65krcibm66e23glihlqj9d8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)___**
---
Now, I don’t care if you’re with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America. ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zt3ffkll88721hm88rvg2p43ehor8j9blotof910_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)_** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zkrv4uha5ag7o0raa08imt5vgogn6ahu4tb0e9c8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c9i62pj2clh2bs)
---
Sincerely,
---

Because when our vote is protected, so is our power. But these last few weeks are the most critical time of an election. We must have the resources to spread our message and reach voters all across the state. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | | = | = | | = | = | | = If we work together, we can protect our democracy from those who seek to destroy it. Divided, we fall. We hope you will stand with us today. Thank you, Team MTO Maggie Toulouse Oliver serves the state of New Mexico as Secretary of State, where she is dedicated to fighting for clean and fair elections devoid of dark money and outside influence. She's up for re-election in 2022, and we need to start building our grassroots movement to keep her seat safe. Help Maggie protect our elections system and create a stronger democracy! clean_body: We're doing a virtual tour of small towns in rural America. | | | Hi Peter – In case you haven't been following along over the last few weeks, our team is doing a virtual tour of small towns and cities across rural America. Our mission at United Rural Democrats is to build a Democratic movement in rural America, especially in districts that have deprioritized their Democratic infrastructure for too long. Today, we're visiting Ironton, Ohio, which is a small city with a population of around 11,000 residents along the Ohio River in Southern Ohio. Much of the district voted overwhelmingly for Trump in 2020, however, Ironton saw pockets of Democratic voters – unique to most of the surrounding area. Democrats lost momentum in the 2020 election, seeing better results during 2016. Ironton, as the name suggests, once had a successful iron and coal industry and had difficulty transitioning to other industries, seeing its population drastically shrink over the last 70 years. Despite the economic challenges, Ironton is a community that's extremely proud of its traditions. The city hosts the oldest, continually held Memorial Day parade in the U.S. At United Rural Democrats, we're proud to be endorsing Democratic candidates who can help rebuild the infrastructure, jobs, small businesses, education, and other resources that Ironton, Ohio, needs to succeed. Democrats like Tim Ryan for U.S. Senate, Jeffery Crossman for Attorney General, and Taylor Sappington for State Auditor need your support to win in Ironton and across the state. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Thank you for supporting Democrats in rural America. – United Rural Democrats United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. name: WelchForVermont.com
subject: Did you hear about the Welch Wagon, Team?
body:
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=1001&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Welch for Vermont

We’re back again with some new happenings from the campaign trail,
Team—see what we’ve been up to at Team Welch these past few
weeks:

Earlier this month, we launched the “Welch Wagon” 14 County Tour! From now
through November’s election, Peter will meet with and listen to Vermonters
in all 14 counties, as part of his ongoing commitment to connect with
Vermonters in their own communities.

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4265?t=1002&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Logo for the 14-county "Welch Wagon" tour

Peter and the Welch Wagon made our first stop in Orleans County. He first
hosted a meet & greet at Newport’s Natural Market and Cafe, then a
community visit (and creemee stop) at Pick and Shovel, and finally closed
the tour with a farm visit to Butterworks Farm in Westfield. It was an
absolutely gorgeous day with some beautiful folks (and cows)—thanks to
everyone who joined us, and be on the lookout for details on the Welch
Wagon’s upcoming stops.

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4265?t=1003&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Peter Welch talking with a hardware store employee

There’s just over six weeks until the midterms, Team, which
means it's all systems go from here on out. With the Senate split down the
middle 50/50, electing Peter could be the difference between protecting
our Democratic majority and keeping power out of Mitch McConnell’s hands.

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4265?t=1004&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Peter Welch eating ice cream with fellow Vermonters
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4265?t=1005&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Peter Welch Butterworks Farm in Westfield, talking with two fellow Vermonters
[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4265?t=1006&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Peter Welch with a cow in a Vermont pasture

We’re hard at work spreading the word about Peter and his progressive
agenda, and we could use your continued support to power him across the
finish line. [ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4266?t=1007&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Can you make a $5 contribution or anything else you can
give to ensure we’ve got everything it takes to elect Peter as Vermont’s
next Senator?

[ https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4265?t=1009&t=1010&akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W ]Donate

With only 43 days until the election, we’ll be sure to keep you updated on
everything happening on the campaign trail, Team. And keep your
eyes and ears open for the Welch Wagon—it might be in your county before
you know it.

Thanks so much!

Welch for Vermont

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.welchforvermont.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=973%2E61531%2EVsHR2W

I’ll be honest with you, friend -- I’m angry.
Last week, Kevin McCarthy rolled out the GOP’s plan if Republicans retake the House in November. This “plan” is chock-full of divisive rhetoric and extremist undertones. What concerns me the most is how this plan will affect our nation’s children -- _your children_.
I’ve been a public school teacher for over 20 years. **Education is our most powerful tool to stay competitive in the global marketplace, support future generations, and learn to respect one another’s differences. **
Kevin McCarthy and the GOP have already taken a sledgehammer to our children’s future by restricting curriculum, banning books, and funneling money away from our public schools. I’ve witnessed firsthand the damage these policies have rendered. The victims aren’t Democrats -- _they’re our children! I will NEVER stand by quietly as our children and their education are threatened._
**We need to be investing in our children’s education, not making it the new ground zero for political culture wars.**
Will you help me halt Kevin McCarthy’s plans to derail our children’s education by chipping in $5 to help me defeat him in November? You can use this link to donate: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mw-vf-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51378203/369180747/1594291383?refcode=em-9.26.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMTIwNTExNy1kNzNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ahk_a9DEakTnI6JTBUd8tjzXVhuGhKJ0WCS-HJm4OD4=)
Children in our district have endured so much these past few years, from remote learning during the pandemic to living in fear of the next school shooting. The last thing students need is another disruption to their education.
When I am in Congress, I will continue to advocate for quality education for ALL students in the Central Valley and High Desert. **I refuse to let our children become political pawns in Kevin McCarthy’s power-grab game. **
Thanks for hearing me out on this, friend.

subject: We didn't see this one coming
body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0852%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=KzQMkGr9OhNlTbN7ieU%2bPA&sysid=1)
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34134%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=f2T%2brHisH%2f5rkd7P7TKzEQ&sysid=1)
---
|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming -- which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34145%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=56PinTFwV1bCLlKogui5mw&sysid=1)
---
[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34146%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=d7k2cLPZwXJyxJTLvHTLaQ&sysid=1)
---
For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” -- so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34147%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FnmESUIHBh6sbwalLN5NnQ&sysid=1) And remember -- you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34148%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OQKlOXYTbJ3iGBQPjYdbDw&sysid=1) Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine. [**Join the rebellion today.**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34149%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ROfI0X00iFpKQoBue4ujIA&sysid=1)
---
Sincerely, Seth Dillon CEO The Babylon Bee

| | **ICYMI: Governor Kelly flips, then flops - on banning males from female sports as campaign pressure mounts** **By Dane Hicks**[ _September 23, 2022, The Anderson County Review_](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=86f4f4c44b8d4c02a65311991c3284d3&_e=lcoXWHtuB0zt85L105JWkjTzEhOcyt5duA_3j9Cu2-pImyHz2bFBLaChOS-qCDnRB-iroh3X1iwpmyxqphwBvRK5mxmbqPvJu6T59RT0yhiFgOcCCEO3rxIJAnib_AAMjvBd1DyrGdrI4GzcJP28a8T4eFibKZ3NMEgROInb875OBolekOayBeBypYq9YN5ZQcj-1YN0tpTLswyI4-DFm2VXhOoSgxfsIa7PSKNhr3kc2UhubqfTZkWM7DXjgd_xYXRi5TpVBlVnqU0A3_YLvXSO8AESj7eSsojAWS00mjeRlUF2GQnKD0qx84scnaDU) TOPEKA – With only weeks to go before the 2022 election and in a race most pollsters are calling a dead heat, Kansas Governor Laura Kelly has apparently reversed course on the transgender sports ban legislation she twiced vetoed – saying “men should not be playing girl’s sports” – then reversing her language again in comments to the Kansas City Star late this week after blowback.

The confusion illustrates the weight of those vetoes on Kelly’s campaign and the rallying point the issue has become for Republicans as the contest for Kansas governor enters its final month.

Kelly’s first 180 degree turn came last week in the latest commercial her campaign released, after her Republican opponent Attorney General Derek Schmidt saw surging support for his position favoring a ban on men competing in Kansas women’s sports at a rally in Olathe with Florida Governor Ron DeSantis the previous Sunday.

Schmidt got standing ovations a number of times from a standing room only crowd of more than 2,000 supporters at Olathe’s Embassy Suites Convention Center, when he doubled down on his previous support for a law passed by the legislature which would have banned men from competing in women’s sports at the high school and college level in Kansas. The bill passed the Kansas Legislature twice in 2020 and 2021, but failed to gain a veto-proof majority in the Kansas House after Kelly blocked the measure both times.

But in her ad, Kelly appeared to reverse her opinion.

“You may have seen my opponent’s attacks, so let me just say it: of course men should not play girls’ sports. OK, we all agree there,” Kelly says in the ad. She spends the remainder of the ad time continuing the theme that a vote for Schmidt is a vote for the policies of former Governor Sam Brownback. Brownback left office in 2018.

But after reaction from both Republicans and from members of the LGBTQ community, Kelly seemed to backpedal in hurried comments to the Kansas City Star Editorial Board on Thursday, saying she supported the NCAA transgender policy that allows males to compete in female collegiate sports, and that her ad comment somehow was pointed at adult men playing female children’s athletics – which has so far not be a public issue.

“We already have a structure in place, the NCAA has a structure in place to deal with issues like this on a one by one basis and I don’t think there’s any other way that you can really deal with this,” Kelly told the Star’s editorial board as reported by the newspaper. Kelly told the board her ad was talking about a male over the age of 18 who wanted to compete with younger girls. She implied her comments were made regarding age and not just gender identity, although that aspect has never been central to the debate to date.

“The ad that I put out was to respond to the misleading attacks that my opponent has put out that I favor letting men play in girls sports,” Kelly said. “I have never said that,” the Star reported.

[Click here to read the whole piece in _The Anderson County Review. _](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=86f4f4c44b8d4c02a65311991c3284d3&_e=lcoXWHtuB0zt85L105JWkjTzEhOcyt5duA_3j9Cu2-pImyHz2bFBLaChOS-qCDnRB-iroh3X1iwpmyxqphwBvRK5mxmbqPvJu6T59RT0yhiFgOcCCEO3rxIJAnib_AAMjvBd1DyrGdrI4GzcJP28a_n2-fR3bWo_5rluhf5l_iuJGOLukGwMNkuGIpHUwcAOPZE5smFvItUaYMJDr9CD7RxpAjGR0GD3uA3Zit4-bzUKIEGJSosGxG_0mm1SwfffDZTG7uYeYPKglwu3mGa2loEJ_8YsOdLgmU5jCfvgBzXLc-Bla1Gdt2BJTVBySQXn) ###

body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6467%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=XFSoqwth49QwrgdbfCeOAg&sysid=1)
| | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76866%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rXBzEpd99ZbkBLUlS0Za4g&sysid=1)

Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We’re a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can’t abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We’ve been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming -- which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76867%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UVIXnDhvHuNEN9FYa3bJgQ&sysid=1)
---
[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76868%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Cb78N5%2fEG0IJX%2fOtwDS%2b1g&sysid=1)
---
For years now, we’ve been building our support base in an effort to become “cancel-proof” -- so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76869%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=t9Bxo0i1T8nPm7tCvZWPEA&sysid=1) And remember -- you won’t just be standing with the Bee; you’ll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can’t take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our “Man of the Year.” But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76860%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bcUYKGKfJmmPFyzYWou9Lw&sysid=1) Our goal is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital world. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can’t win. They can try to strike us down, but we will become more powerful than they could possibly imagine. [**Join the rebellion today.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76861%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5K29QF0ZiIRxT3zASQSO2w&sysid=1)
---
Sincerely, Seth Dillon CEO The Babylon Bee

name: Laurie Teper
subject: Still Work to Do!
body:
Hello Dedicated Volunteers!
On behalf of Courtney Geels, I want to say THANK YOU to everyone who has contributed to the success of her campaign and sticking with us this far. It's not over yet!

As September draws to an end **we have a lot of work still left to do before voting begins** **October 20!** **Door knocking** **and booths at festivals** are proving to be very successful as we talk to people. Once they hear about Courtney, many have said "Well now I will definitely vote!" They may not have otherwise. Some say they don't know anything about her, but they said they have seen her signs. It then gives us an opportunity to tell them about her. Many have said, "Is she the nurse?" Name recognition is important and we are reaching people through door knocking, mailers, phone calling, manning booths at festivals, putting out signs, community outreach, and networking which is ongoing through November 8. All of these things come at a cost. The cost of finances, time and energy. We know we still have to sacrifice these things. Did you know that a 30 second commercial on a Sunday afternoon costs $5000.00? You can be sure that Valerie Foushee will be airing her commercials soon! **Can I be so bold as to ask each one of you to donate $20 or more****even if you have contributed in the past****so that she can get a commercial on prime time TV? Together, we can have an impact!**
**Please donate here:**<https://secure.winred.com/courtney-geels-for-congress/donate-today>

Remember, EVERY VOTER MATTERS AND EVERY VOTE COUNTS!

_**Upcoming Opportunities For You to Help Make a Difference**_

_GRANVILLE DOOR KNOCKING - We need you!_
9:00am-12:00pm
Creedmoor/Butner parking lot - We will equip you with everything you need
Courtney & Bryan attending
Please contact Noah to sign up

** _POLLS -_**_We need you! Oct 20-Nov 5 and NOVEMBER 8!_
Thank you to those who are already signed up. We need so many more of you to step up and say "YES, I will sacrifice my time to hand out Courtney's cards!" According to Bryan Geels, **" We saw that it moved the percentage toward Courtney between 3-5% points at every place we had someone standing at the primaries." **That is huge, especially in blue counties. **Please contact your county coordinator OR me ASAP** to sign up before someone calls you! Poll training is available via Google Meet from Courtney if you are interested in that. We will send you the link to join the training if you like. NO NEED TO FEAR!

body:
| | |
---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** September 26, 2022**CONTACT:** Gabriella Shanahan, gabriella@scottgryder.com
---
**Gryder Endorsed by Ag Leader Phil Nelson** _Nelson backs Gryder who will fight for Illinois ag in D.C._
---
| | **Oswego, Ill**. – Congressional candidate for IL-14 and Kendall County Board Chairman Scott Gryder is announcing today the campaign endorsement of Phil Nelson. A leader in the Illinois agriculture industry, Nelson is the former president of the Illinois Farm Bureau and the former Illinois Director of Agriculture. “Agriculture isn’t just a major industry in Illinois, it’s a way of life for many Illinoisans. I’m honored to have the endorsement of Phil Nelson, who knows the agriculture industry in Illinois and understands the unique challenges faced today,” **said Gryder.** “We’re truly blessed to have some of the best farmland in the world along with hardworking and innovative farmers. This industry has progressed quickly in recent years, going from the average U.S. farmer feeding 28 people to 155 people today. “But on the other hand, we are seeing more regulations for our farmers coming out of D.C. from Democrats like Joe Biden and Lauren Underwood who are pushing a Green New Deal that is harmful to the farming industry. Imposing burdensome regulations that will restrain American ag and energy is not the way to treat our farmers, nor is 8% inflation, skyrocketing fuel prices, or fertilizer shortages. Farmers have it tough this year thanks to Biden and Underwood, and in November we have the chance to prioritize ag again with Republicans.” Nelson adds, “Scott Gryder stands for less government, less regulations, and representing each and every one of you.”
---

name: Val Demings
subject: thank you for dreaming with me
body:
Derek –
I wanted to take a moment to personally say thank you.
Thank you for dreaming of a better Senate with me – one that works for the people , not just for the corporate elites.
Thank you for fighting by my side every step of the way in this race – through all the victories and setbacks.
Thank you for helping me give Marco Rubio the toughest fight of his career.
And now I'll be up-front about where we stand: I'm 1 point down in recent polls, and once again I'm counting on this powerful grassroots team to help with the resources I need to surge ahead in these final weeks.
So I have to ask: Will you split a contribution of $25 or more right now to help me defeat Marco Rubio and defend our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_vd?refcode=20220926_CGVA_Demings]

| Peter,
Las Vegas-area schools have ranked worst in the nation for quality, and our state is ranked 49th in education - how is this acceptable?
Unlike Sisolak, I have a plan in place for education to make schools safer and more equipped to prepare future generations of Nevadans (read more about my priorities [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pe9DPkeTMB5FC-zQmtlQaJ1DX93RmggnPVLbxAoO_DSSxZxcAO9l3Lmm3TkEBGm3nDbsyo3OzMa1CXEIlazNS_6fIQfheEVGMaHPozVkh9AKu1eC26M6QERuDo0LUmKVKcTM4Y1JoPCuAFoZbY69wW7w2UOBB4kHlDDanlm0zJOYr5i61yOMNg==&c=Llc48tOFdCxpBNh5liG5eY_Xf8o1s5yBvJ4sNs5qmnxgYPEQVM5BxA==&ch=46jzhRKYPpQcRa6vh_yDaRxF3sRKz3ZyGfY5gwuKZxsOW1qd4hagvg==)). It includes measures like restoring the Read by Grade 3 Program and protecting teachers and students from the spike in violence and other crimes within Clark County School District that have happened under Sisolak's watch.
I'm ready to get to work fixing our schools and education system. [I hope you'll keep up the support for my campaign so I can get the job done. >>](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pe9DPkeTMB5FC-zQmtlQaJ1DX93RmggnPVLbxAoO_DSSxZxcAO9l3Lmm3TkEBGm3WtM-Ucovi6sUqzQk9My1WRfb3pw5f3vNYepJhXhOGSlmAW6Qc5Ld6ccnCsuxFgNIJsNUuAmkY-hS8JShpCRQd0sahJEYHOzIaEmq_6JdQVXsyR-2fVIof2y7J_HqbYaR2H2fCXMxMId5OSPd78KfKPC_QSar3rfITI4yGDCXnsw=&c=Llc48tOFdCxpBNh5liG5eY_Xf8o1s5yBvJ4sNs5qmnxgYPEQVM5BxA==&ch=46jzhRKYPpQcRa6vh_yDaRxF3sRKz3ZyGfY5gwuKZxsOW1qd4hagvg==)

subject: My mentor, Brenda
body:
| |

Friend, I wanted to take a moment to tell you why I am so passionately supporting Brenda to be our next Governor. **** I have had the honor of having Brenda as my mentor for the past few years as we've worked on advocacy projects together. Brenda guided me through planning my first press conference, through designing my first petition, and through meeting with legislators and government officials. In doing all this, Brenda has fueled a movement against homelessness. **** Brenda is a champion for all Vermonters and she slept on the statehouse steps for 27 nights to ensure all Vermonters had access to housing. Because of Brenda, hundreds of Vermonters experiencing homelessness got access to shelter around the state in the heart of winter. **** Currently, 550,000 people are homeless in the United States, where nobody should be sleeping outside on the streets. Yet that is still the case from California to Maine. **** We need leaders who are willing to shake up the status quo and pass policy to address this dire issue. I know, if elected as governor, Brenda will make it her mission to end homelessness in our state. She cares deeply about the most vulnerable Vermonters, and she won’t stop until everyone gets the resources they need and can thrive in our state. **** Brenda is passionate about making a huge difference in the opioid crisis, and has a strong history of leadership in standing alongside others for racial justice. She is the only candidate who has released a plan to fully protect reproductive and civil liberty. She is a bold leader who knows how to get things done, and as governor, she would move our brave little state in a bright direction. **** As a young person, I am really anxious about the future. With the looming climate crisis, racial injustice, and poverty all on the line, I feel a sense of urgency to make change for the better. I’m with Brenda because I know Brenda will work to solve the issues that plague Vermont instead of continuing the status quo. Brenda has a major deadline coming up, and she needs our help reaching every Vermonter and informing them of her plans to build a better Vermont. **U.S. Chamber of Commerce Endorses Congressman Steve Chabot** _Leading Business Group Says Chabot “Understands the Challenges and Economic Needs Facing the Workforce and Families in Ohio” — Highlights “Strong Record of Leadership and Delivering Results”_ _ _ **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** September 26, 2022 Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) LEBANON, OHIO — The U.S. Chamber of Commerce [endorsed](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=adaa6155f41d4941a8be5df5f63a461d&_e=OlJ11iPEAyweKhsJQzLXkKQJwxA_71BYzFrRQMM2sE-vD1oK_Rgf3HqXff61vixhsXwTOQwEjyCKm8W_U2IgUvkjFwjwYPj8ZsKKnJN_gYQ5PKF1m518DoJN316S5MRtc-W2_a2Dqb94JxErjgiZWQY7XLAOw5ZpcXeLjLXg_FnFO92L-nzjfciT3aGeaRFJYimB7z1r5yBBpYBKPMIHeQgbeKg1Ocb_eqZVp_dbTuzO5Yk-kUsit003uzCZAsLq6Ak8UA7MYQ7u9nwKtzRBlHAWHto1pY4Pj47J_DDW-dWdA-BwsBsR-C2h7EsDnXFqY4S3SrcZzywX1E0YRCBA1g%3D%3D) Congressman Steve Chabot for reelection on Monday following a “Fighting for Ohio Jobs and Families” roundtable and tour at E-Beam Services in Lebanon. During the event, Chabot met with local businesses, community leaders and workers to discuss the historic challenges facing businesses and hardworking families and his priorities for tackling inflation, addressing supply chain issues, and strengthening our economy to create greater prosperity for businesses and their employees. Read the full release from the U.S. Chamber of Commerce on their endorsement [here](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=adaa6155f41d4941a8be5df5f63a461d&_e=OlJ11iPEAyweKhsJQzLXkKQJwxA_71BYzFrRQMM2sE-vD1oK_Rgf3HqXff61vixhsXwTOQwEjyCKm8W_U2IgUvkjFwjwYPj8ZsKKnJN_gYQ5PKF1m518DoJN316S5MRtc-W2_a2Dqb94JxErjgiZWQY7XLAOw5ZpcXeLjLXg_FnFO92L-nzjfciT3aGeaRFJuW9G5R06XmmdEi8Yhx94fFQuli0oyeyJj-IxLzsELVZvJ1k4HB4HkdmezrfWiFuHUhRTWQb7MF0PtJqYI66NQsmS77igEZ5WjWLttYrtcaxOiPRS-gTNTGjzDj-4E9F6gvw2_dcRjEStjESBAFrC9g%3D%3D): **_U.S. Chamber Endorses Rep. Steve Chabot for Ohio’s 1st Congressional District_** September 26, 2022 Lebanon, OH – Today, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce announced its endorsement of Representative Steve Chabot (R) to represent Ohio’s First Congressional District. The Chamber endorses pro-business candidates for federal office who will vigorously support public policy that will advance economic growth, support jobs, and promote fiscal responsibility. “Rep. Steve Chabot’s strong record of leadership and delivering results for the constituents of southwest Ohio are significant,” said Ryan Gleason, U.S. Chamber of Commerce Manager, Great Lakes Regional Office. “Congressman Chabot understands the challenges and economic needs facing the workforce and families in Ohio, and he is committed to pro-growth policies and free enterprise solutions that will move our nation forward. The U.S. Chamber is proud to support Rep. Chabot in his re-election.” “I’m incredibly honored to have the support of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and the many incredible businesses they and their affiliated regional and local chamber organizations represent in Ohio and the First Congressional District,” Congressman Chabot said. “I’m proud of my record of delivering results for our business community and hardworking families and am focused on addressing the unprecedented challenges they face from record inflation, supply chain pressures, labor shortages, soaring energy costs, tax hikes, and more. I look forward to leveraging my depth of experience, proven ability to build consensus and get things done on a bipartisan basis, and willingness to stand up and vocally oppose misguided policies in the next Congress to unleash the full power of American enterprise and small business to create greater prosperity for our region and our nation.” “Rep. Chabot is a demonstrated leader in Congress. During my 10 years on Capitol Hill, I saw firsthand Steve’s ability to promote a pro-business agenda for the people of southeast Ohio,” said former Congressman Steve Stivers, President and CEO of the Ohio Chamber of Commerce. “He understands the importance of reducing excessive tax burdens on American businesses and advocating for small businesses. I congratulate Rep. Chabot on receiving this well-earned endorsement from the U.S. Chamber. Ohio’s business community looks forward to seeing him again in the next Congress.” ###

Peter,

You likely receive 10+ emails a day from politicians asking for money, promising to solve all your problems, and telling you the sky is falling...

_This is NOT one of those emails_.

I'm sending you a personal follow up about my message for the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)... **I haven 't heard back from you and I'm worried you're either ignoring me or worse, you're giving up on our fight for liberty. **

This is one of the last times I'll try reaching you about this.

I connected with Zilvinas Silenas (he lets me call him "Z" for short), the President of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE), and made him a BIG promise.

**Before I tell you what I promised Z, let me tell you _his story about growing up under the Soviet Union and how he 's fighting for liberty_:**

Z was born in Lithuania and lived under the rule of the evil Soviet Union.

He grew up in poverty, without rights to free speech or economic liberties, and remembers listening to state-sponsored radio. His family knew the media was simply a propaganda machine for the Communist regime.

He has since moved to the United States and dedicated his life's work to fighting for liberty, free market capitalism, and defeating socialism.

I'm proud to call Z my friend and support the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

FEE is educating both high school and college students about the true principles of free markets, entrepreneurship, individual liberties, and personal responsibility. Their flagship program, "FEE In the Classroom" is teaching students these important lessons and values in order to save our Republic from socialism.

**Here is the promise I gave Z: **

[_**I promised to help raise $25,000 from my personal supporters for FEE 's mission to educate high school students about liberty and free markets. Please click here to donate $1,000, $500, $100, $50, $25, or any amount you can send today.**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411068:JqjhofVN0:m:1:3317145305:10D8AE66BE1D40D7933824AA428FDB0C:r)

When I gave Z my word he nearly fainted and dropped his phone in shock.

You see, this is personal for him.

Can you imagine growing up under the rule of the Soviet Union? Z has personally witnessed the destruction of socialism and has vowed to defeat it in the United States.

I believe he can.

But he needs your help.

The Foundation for Economic Education has served as America's top free-market educator. In fact, President Ronald Reagan read FEE's materials and some of the greatest economists in our country's history have worked for FEE:**Milton Friedman, F.A. Hayek, Ludwig Von Mises and more. **

Here's an ugly truth for you, Peter... Politicians will not save us.

My campaign is about to report our fundraising to the FEC. It's the final quarterly reporting deadline before Election Day, and all eyes will be on our numbers to see if: A. We have the strength to defend this seat, or B. We're in a position of weakness, which will motivate the GOP to pile on attacks.
As I write to you, we're facing a $17,781 shortfall.
I need to explain to you why this cannot happen ahead of an FEC deadline - and why I'm counting on you to make your very first donation at this urgent moment.
But first, let me say how deeply appreciative I am for your support of this campaign. This operation is powered by people like you - people who believe in our shared Democratic values; who are committed to fighting back against Trump, McConnell, and GOP extremists everywhere; and who contribute their time and talent to protect every Democratic seat.
However, with Mitch McConnell only needing to flip a single seat to take back control, there's _no_ room for error or falling short on resources. Especially now, when RNC Chairwoman Ronna McDaniel and Senate GOP campaign Chairman Rick Scott have descended on Connecticut to help fundraise for my Trump-endorsed opponent.
It's clear they are making this seat a target. It's clear that in the final, most crucial weeks of the election, we must be in a position of strength to fight back. Which means it's clear that I cannot fall short ahead of the most important fundraising deadline of the campaign.
**It 's your donation, Friend, that could prevent us from publicly reporting that we are under-resourced. It's your donation that will ensure we can combat GOP attacks, win, and protect and EXPAND Democratic Senate control.**
**[So please, will you donate $5 or more to protect this Democratic Senate seat and ensure control of the Senate stays out of the hands of Mitch McConnell?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1259-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

| | Peter, The establishment and political class have failed America.
They've failed Arizona. They are only concerned about their OWN power, so they refuse to address the real problems we face. That's why the problems just get worse. They ARE what's broken. That's why we need an outsider NOW who can get things done.** ** **[I AGREE >>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61410537:6GTDGfVQN:m:1:3253819041:E3260BA5E07E53FD5A468C583ACF88CD:r)** _Just think about it ... Ronald Reagan didn't have political experience or government experience. President Donald Trump didn't either. We had great policies from these people._ I intend to bring policies to Arizona that are EQUALLY as great. I'm not coming into this game as a politician with a ruling class attitude. I'm taking on our real issues as a proud mom and as an American who is horrified by the action - and inaction - we're seeing in our government.
I think we're ready for another outsider to bring greatness to the people.**__** **_[Are you with me?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61410537:6GTDGfVQN:m:1:3253819041:E3260BA5E07E53FD5A468C583ACF88CD:r) _**

We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**[**Will you help me defeat her?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61410537:6GTDGfVQN:m:1:3253819041:E3260BA5E07E53FD5A468C583ACF88CD:r)

Peter,

You likely receive 10+ emails a day from politicians asking for money, promising to solve all your problems, and telling you the sky is falling...

_This is NOT one of those emails_.

I'm sending you a personal follow up about my message for the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)... **I haven 't heard back from you and I'm worried you're either ignoring me or worse, you're giving up on our fight for liberty. **

This is one of the last times I'll try reaching you about this.

I connected with Zilvinas Silenas (he lets me call him "Z" for short), the President of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE), and made him a BIG promise.

**Before I tell you what I promised Z, let me tell you _his story about growing up under the Soviet Union and how he 's fighting for liberty_:**

Z was born in Lithuania and lived under the rule of the evil Soviet Union.

He grew up in poverty, without rights to free speech or economic liberties, and remembers listening to state-sponsored radio. His family knew the media was simply a propaganda machine for the Communist regime.

He has since moved to the United States and dedicated his life's work to fighting for liberty, free market capitalism, and defeating socialism.

I'm proud to call Z my friend and support the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

FEE is educating both high school and college students about the true principles of free markets, entrepreneurship, individual liberties, and personal responsibility. Their flagship program, "FEE In the Classroom" is teaching students these important lessons and values in order to save our Republic from socialism.

**Here is the promise I gave Z: **

[_**I promised to help raise $25,000 from my personal supporters for FEE 's mission to educate high school students about liberty and free markets. Please click here to donate $1,000, $500, $100, $50, $25, or any amount you can send today.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411112:JxXRGfVrN:m:1:3331421248:16878E37F0D91EF386B48C392B54C98B:r)

When I gave Z my word he nearly fainted and dropped his phone in shock.

You see, this is personal for him.

Can you imagine growing up under the rule of the Soviet Union? Z has personally witnessed the destruction of socialism and has vowed to defeat it in the United States.

I believe he can.

But he needs your help.

The Foundation for Economic Education has served as America's top free-market educator. In fact, President Ronald Reagan read FEE's materials and some of the greatest economists in our country's history have worked for FEE:**Milton Friedman, F.A. Hayek, Ludwig Von Mises and more. **

Here's an ugly truth for you, Peter... Politicians will not save us.

Trust me, I see them at work every day.

The reality is, we must change the culture and educate the next generation about the principles of liberty and free enterprise. That's why I am asking you to donate to the Foundation for Economic Education:

**U.S. Chamber of Commerce Endorses Congressman Steve Chabot** _Leading Business Group Says Chabot “Understands the Challenges and Economic Needs Facing the Workforce and Families in Ohio” — Highlights “Strong Record of Leadership and Delivering Results”_ _ _ **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** September 26, 2022 Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) LEBANON, OHIO — The U.S. Chamber of Commerce [endorsed](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=04b51cb2e2234e268ed5d5d2af875717&_e=FwjQ8laFgRBdWlK5emwAbH5PKwNk7YrcLKFA6p-FkP7KCicBw2w-GBZjZhR5M5qRixdo4bUTHZpp55WWstqIQXraBzo31JilvkVMOMq-TYndMosChVailak4zqlIahg_ONZYFxK22JvxRjzaxRokcW2rC6AAsqOVSseuAhGfjyYhP9dxT_wr2wvieiXDiOn2PWr6Lq_wX3roceAhBBHxct_IZFhVJQlVLzMfMSOsjQR2svO0WwrnSYGqISEcPCLDDzDXf5Yw1AF7AyBlK0sxvV-rTaR9uA7HwRUOTxRZWwwxrp5rokWL-a6tn1VWMcWhk1-H_1bq9BuVxkIwFLib5w%3D%3D) Congressman Steve Chabot for reelection on Monday following a “Fighting for Ohio Jobs and Families” roundtable and tour at E-Beam Services in Lebanon. During the event, Chabot met with local businesses, community leaders and workers to discuss the historic challenges facing businesses and hardworking families and his priorities for tackling inflation, addressing supply chain issues, and strengthening our economy to create greater prosperity for businesses and their employees. Read the full release from the U.S. Chamber of Commerce on their endorsement [here](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=04b51cb2e2234e268ed5d5d2af875717&_e=FwjQ8laFgRBdWlK5emwAbH5PKwNk7YrcLKFA6p-FkP7KCicBw2w-GBZjZhR5M5qRixdo4bUTHZpp55WWstqIQXraBzo31JilvkVMOMq-TYndMosChVailak4zqlIahg_ONZYFxK22JvxRjzaxRokcW2rC6AAsqOVSseuAhGfjyYhP9dxT_wr2wvieiXDiOn2vO0AFceFbadjm8WG9SDMiHKyN01o9xDaQFY-AXMLaaPq0WLNxiDamlbekGMDitesiN-Pv61Zak2BL4TI2nsdFRSWJI230BdOg0jNxct_lfRRn1rdO_MjzbO27BfWpUW3DOrQeW0z-QfmzfCuYvXQGg%3D%3D): **_U.S. Chamber Endorses Rep. Steve Chabot for Ohio’s 1st Congressional District_** September 26, 2022 Lebanon, OH – Today, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce announced its endorsement of Representative Steve Chabot (R) to represent Ohio’s First Congressional District. The Chamber endorses pro-business candidates for federal office who will vigorously support public policy that will advance economic growth, support jobs, and promote fiscal responsibility. “Rep. Steve Chabot’s strong record of leadership and delivering results for the constituents of southwest Ohio are significant,” said Ryan Gleason, U.S. Chamber of Commerce Manager, Great Lakes Regional Office. “Congressman Chabot understands the challenges and economic needs facing the workforce and families in Ohio, and he is committed to pro-growth policies and free enterprise solutions that will move our nation forward. The U.S. Chamber is proud to support Rep. Chabot in his re-election.” “I’m incredibly honored to have the support of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and the many incredible businesses they and their affiliated regional and local chamber organizations represent in Ohio and the First Congressional District,” Congressman Chabot said. “I’m proud of my record of delivering results for our business community and hardworking families and am focused on addressing the unprecedented challenges they face from record inflation, supply chain pressures, labor shortages, soaring energy costs, tax hikes, and more. I look forward to leveraging my depth of experience, proven ability to build consensus and get things done on a bipartisan basis, and willingness to stand up and vocally oppose misguided policies in the next Congress to unleash the full power of American enterprise and small business to create greater prosperity for our region and our nation.” “Rep. Chabot is a demonstrated leader in Congress. During my 10 years on Capitol Hill, I saw firsthand Steve’s ability to promote a pro-business agenda for the people of southeast Ohio,” said former Congressman Steve Stivers, President and CEO of the Ohio Chamber of Commerce. “He understands the importance of reducing excessive tax burdens on American businesses and advocating for small businesses. I congratulate Rep. Chabot on receiving this well-earned endorsement from the U.S. Chamber. Ohio’s business community looks forward to seeing him again in the next Congress.” ###

subject: I'll never stop fighting to protect and serve

body:
While I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician
| | |
---
Friend: This is an especially important message about my 27 years of dedicated service as a police officer. As Marco Rubio launches desperate attacks on my law enforcement career, I hope you'll read this to the end.
I entered the police academy because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm. After graduating at the top of my class, I woke up and put on my uniform every day, ready to risk my life because _ _ I took an oath to protect and serve the people of Florida.
**While I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician. **I’ll put my record up against his any day – but the problem is, Rubio has the powerful influence of the GOP dark-money machine on his side.
As national Republicans spend millions of dollars on attack ads that question my loyalty to the men and women in law enforcement, I need your help today to set the record straight: [**Will you donate $5 or more to help me reach more voters and flip Florida blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51369552/369148829/-1315874399?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4491-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTUzOGJkNC1jMDNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KK43wrjpbzJDhseVMouIVUMGv-Xn_72SW7YKP8Quswg=)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51369553/369148830/-1315874399?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4491-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTUzOGJkNC1jMDNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KK43wrjpbzJDhseVMouIVUMGv-Xn_72SW7YKP8Quswg=)
Back in 1983, **I was one of only three women in my police academy class**. But after years of hard work and dedication, I rose to the top of the department and became the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.
My story doesn't stop there. When I was appointed chief of police, Orlando was in crisis. The murder rate was at an all-time high, but I brought the department together and built relationships within the community. Standing with the brave men and women of the Orlando Police Department, we reduced violent crime by 40%.

name: Charles Booker
subject: Rand Paul’s #1 priority
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, we can’t
afford six more years of Rand Paul.

This is Rand Paul’s top priority if he wins re-election this year: getting
his dangerous Life at Conception Act through the Senate.

The “Life at Conception Act” is the next step for dangerous anti-women
legislators – a total and unequivocal nationwide ban on abortion, without
exception for rape or incest. Peter,
this law is so extreme, 80 percent of the
country does not support it.

I wish this man cared as much about Kentuckians as he does about his
obsession with sending reproductive rights back decades.

While Rand is plotting his next anti-science, anti-women bill, the people
of the state he represents — my family — are suffering.

We are at the bottom of nearly every quality of life index. Our schools
are underfunded, hundreds of thousands of people haven’t had clean
drinking water in decades, and one in four people in Appalachia are living
in poverty.

I can promise you,
Peter, playing political games
isn’t going to be on the top of my mind if I get elected to the Senate.
The people of Kentucky are — and have always been — my top priority.

From ensuring that folks can afford their prescription drugs to creating
economic opportunities in communities that have been left behind. These
are the things that people care about. And that’s exactly what I’m going
to do when I get to the United States Senate.

We’re working to build a campaign that represents ALL of us, from the hood
to the holler. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18699?refcode=em20220926-2524&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=2524%2E346206%2ENLARrw ]Will you chip in $5 or anything you can
right now to support our movement to replace Rand Paul?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18699?refcode=em20220926-2524&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=2524%2E346206%2ENLARrw ]Contribute $5

Rand Paul has voted down countless bills that would support workers and
families who have been hurt the most in this pandemic. And now instead of
focusing on ways to help Kentucky — he’s planning his next political show.

Enough is enough. I’m running to replace Rand Paul because the cost of
inaction is too high.

I’ve lived in poverty. I’ve been unhoused. I’ve lost family members to gun
violence. I am still paying off my student loans. And I know that when our
politicians ignore these struggles, our pain only continues.

Together, we have the power to change the future of Kentucky. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18699?refcode=em20220926-2524&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=2524%2E346206%2ENLARrw ]But this
kind of deep organizing work requires significant resources and funding.
Please chip in $5 or anything you can today so that we can
sustain this work to replace Rand Paul.

Together,

Charles

| | | Friend, I’m sure that you weren’t expecting to hear from me today, but I’m reaching out to you now not as an actor, or a former (fictional) President, but as a concerned fellow American. Before I explain why, **[let me personally ask you to make a matched $5 contribution to my friends at the DSCC to help them hold the Senate majority >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/9922?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20220926-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220926-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&akid=7046%2E9716520%2EtXDrl0)**

I’ve been an activist for almost my entire life, and I have to be honest with you -- I can’t ever remember a midterm election with more at stake than this one. And now, with just weeks left to go and some early voting _already starting_ , **we all have a choice to make.**

Will we do everything we can to hold the Democratic Senate majority -- the majority that confirmed Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court, passed historic infrastructure and climate change legislation, and achieved the most meaningful gun safety reforms in nearly 30 years? Or will we let Republicans retake power and drag our country backward?

I just talked with the folks over at the DSCC, and they told me they have an important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline in just a few days that will go a long way toward deciding which choice we'll make in this election. **They're running short of their must-hit goal, so I agreed to step in and help -- but I can't do it alone.**

**A group of generous donors is TRIPLING the next $10,000 contributed to the DSCC to make sure they have the resources to defend our Senate majority. ****[So please, rush $5 _(becomes $15)_ to help us defeat the forces looking to drag us backward >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/9922?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20220926-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220926-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&akid=7046%2E9716520%2EtXDrl0)**

Two years ago, together, we saw through the fog of deception, divisiveness, and selfishness that defined the Trump era. We remembered something that is a deep part of our humanity -- and that is that we serve ourselves best when we serve others first.

We can't forget that part of ourselves and go back to the way things were going under Republican rule.

**That's why this election is so important -- not just to me, but for you, too.****[So please: Join me right now and make your matched contribution to defend our Democratic Senate.](https://go.dscc.org/go/9922?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20220926-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20220926-MartinSheen-SheenEmail4-Pros-sl1&akid=7046%2E9716520%2EtXDrl0)**

Thank you,
Martin Sheen

Hi there, Peter. I hope you are doing well.

In just a moment, I’m going to ask you for a $3 donation to my campaign for Congress. We’re coming up on our final FEC deadline before Election Day, so I wanted to reach out personally and explain why your support is so important – especially right now.

As you may know, the Federal Election Commission requires candidates to file a public report every three months showing how much they’ve raised and how many people have contributed.

It’s no secret that fundraising is a huge measure of a campaign’s strength, but it’s even more significant when it’s the last FEC deadline before ballots are counted.

During this race, Ken Calvert and his corporate PAC allies reported larger fundraising hauls than we have. This time, we can pull ahead of him -- and we want to do it without a dime of corporate PAC cash. That’s where you come in:

We set a goal of generating as many individual donations as possible before this deadline hits to send a message that we can defeat the special interests trying to buy this seat. If you can, please send in $3 – or whatever amount makes sense – to help us win this race.

Here’s a good link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rollins-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51398801/369200801/192312732?refcode=em-9.26.22-nopnrs-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTkxMjg2Zi1lODNkLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j3C636uFs1yVN7swrbWflcJH6uFQfC35hm9Ni-aRDT0=)**

So thank you for being part of this people-powered campaign.

In this time of unprecedented challenges in our country, we need an unprecedented response. We need a movement of people who will fight for justice and stand together against greed, oligarchy, authoritarianism, and bigotry.

Mandela Barnes is building that kind of movement through his campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. He is bringing together a multi-racial, multi-generational movement of people who understand that the billionaire class cannot have it all. Friend,

The hosts of The View have always been ignorant Hollywood elitists.

But this time, they took it to a whole new level.

I am the latest target of The View's identity politics. This week, one host came after me for using my middle name, "Nikki," and accused me of whitewashing my family heritage.

Nikki is an Indian name. It's on my birth certificate--and I'm proud of that.

But Hollywood Leftists like Sunny Hostin and Whoppi Goldberg are all too eager to tear down hard-working minority women like me without a second thought.

name: Rand Paul
subject: Did you give up?
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411103:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)

Peter,

You likely receive 10+ emails a day from politicians asking for money, promising to solve all your problems, and telling you the sky is falling...

_This is NOT one of those emails_.

I'm sending you a personal follow up about my message for the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE)... **I haven 't heard back from you and I'm worried you're either ignoring me or worse, you're giving up on our fight for liberty. **

This is one of the last times I'll try reaching you about this.

I connected with Zilvinas Silenas (he lets me call him "Z" for short), the President of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE), and made him a BIG promise.

**Before I tell you what I promised Z, let me tell you _his story about growing up under the Soviet Union and how he 's fighting for liberty_:**

Z was born in Lithuania and lived under the rule of the evil Soviet Union.

He grew up in poverty, without rights to free speech or economic liberties, and remembers listening to state-sponsored radio. His family knew the media was simply a propaganda machine for the Communist regime.

He has since moved to the United States and dedicated his life's work to fighting for liberty, free market capitalism, and defeating socialism.

I'm proud to call Z my friend and support the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

FEE is educating both high school and college students about the true principles of free markets, entrepreneurship, individual liberties, and personal responsibility. Their flagship program, "FEE In the Classroom" is teaching students these important lessons and values in order to save our Republic from socialism.

**Here is the promise I gave Z: **

[_**I promised to help raise $25,000 from my personal supporters for FEE 's mission to educate high school students about liberty and free markets. Please click here to donate $1,000, $500, $100, $50, $25, or any amount you can send today.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411103:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)

When I gave Z my word he nearly fainted and dropped his phone in shock.

You see, this is personal for him.

Can you imagine growing up under the rule of the Soviet Union? Z has personally witnessed the destruction of socialism and has vowed to defeat it in the United States.

I believe he can.

But he needs your help.

The Foundation for Economic Education has served as America's top free-market educator. In fact, President Ronald Reagan read FEE's materials and some of the greatest economists in our country's history have worked for FEE:**Milton Friedman, F.A. Hayek, Ludwig Von Mises and more. **

Here's an ugly truth for you, Peter... Politicians will not save us.

Trust me, I see them at work every day.

The reality is, we must change the culture and educate the next generation about the principles of liberty and free enterprise. That's why I am asking you to donate to the Foundation for Economic Education:

[_**Donate $25 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411104:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411105:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411106:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411107:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411108:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411109:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411110:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411111:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>> **_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411103:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)

This is personal for my wife Kelli and I as well.

Watching our kids grow up, it was always my desire to pass on my love for America, my passion for liberty, and belief in free markets to my children.

You and I must invest in the next generation of young leaders and teach them about the values and ideas we care so deeply about.

Can I count on you? Will you reply to this email by making a donation?

I told Z I would help FEE raise $25,000 in the next 72 hours._He is counting on me to fulfill that promise_.

Which is why I am asking my top online supporters to make a donation.

[_**Please click here to donate $1,000, $500, $100, $50, $25 or any amount.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61411103:JwMhwfVTN:m:1:3253819041:CAB65F4C4D6C9D8DC5D1DC2BDF73C824:r)

Your support means a lot to both Z and myself.

Let's build the next generation of pro-liberty leaders and spread our message of limited government, free enterprise, and economic liberty.

Thank you,

Rand Paul, M.D., U.S. Senator

body:
I wanted to reach out personally to explain why our upcoming FEC deadline is our most important yet.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/8q7LaEFWMBlwmtOp28607BRq7Da4rnDo5g6nwGC_pps=/X0gUTGbXc-dEQFBB-4qVSxsdsfStvwxoVKfbsnmyolo=?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2022.09.26_b1_gs_all) Friend - I wanted to reach out personally to explain why **our upcoming FEC deadline is our most important yet.** I hope you'll take a moment to read this email all the way through, but if you don't have time (that's okay!), please consider contributing to our end-of-quarter fundraising goal: [**secure.actblue.com/donate/stanton_eoq322?refcode=EOQ3**](https://act.myngp.com/el/8q7LaEFWMBlwmtOp28607BRq7Da4rnDo5g6nwGC_pps=/X0gUTGbXc-dEQFBB-4qVSxsdsfStvwxoVKfbsnmyolo=?amount=5&refcode=em_fr_2022.09.26_b1_gs_all)

At midnight on September 30, we will close the books on our final fundraising quarter of the election. name: Official AOC Campaign
subject: How about a thought experiment?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
What if Alexandria wasn’t in Congress...
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220926-3427-header&t=1&akid=3427%2E2526796%2EgJ8IBz)
Envision a world in which Alexandria is not re-elected to Congress — or worse yet, was never elected in the first place...
Sorry for the scary image, but it’s almost October after all. 🎃
In this world, the Green New Deal doesn’t fundamentally reshape the national conversation around climate change. The $2 billion National FEMA Funeral Assistance Program isn’t created, leaving thousands of families of COVID-19 victims without help to bury their loved ones. Michael Cohen isn’t asked during his congressional testimony about Trump’s history of inflating his assets — and last week’s lawsuit from the Attorney General against the Trump family for fraud doesn’t happen. The list could go on...
Spelling it out like this makes you appreciate just how crucial AOC’s voice has become in Congress and to the national political conversation.
But we’re a democracy, and no elected representative is entitled to their seat. Every two years, Congresspeople have to run their campaigns and secure votes from the constituents who trust them — even the popular ones. AOC is no exception and takes this renewal of trust very seriously.
[Even though it’s only been four years in office, Congress would be a very different place without AOC. Will you chip in $3 to Alexandria’s re-election fund today to show AOC how much we appreciate her bringing the interests of the working class to D.C?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220926-1.MSnTlF&refcode=em20220926-3427-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3427%2E2526796%2EgJ8IBz)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220926-1.MSnTlF&refcode=em20220926-3427-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3427%2E2526796%2EgJ8IBz)**
As we wrap up this quarter of the year and move towards the start of a third term, it’s important to reflect on how far we’ve come and how grateful we are to the mass movement that has taken up this work to fight for an equitable future. But that work never ends — so we must stay vigilant and continually renew our commitment the same way Alexandria does.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220926-1?refcode=em20220926-3427-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&t=22&refcode2=3427_2526796_gJ8IBz&akid=3427%2E2526796%2EgJ8IBz)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220926-3427-P_FND_EOQ_GFM&t=23&akid=3427%2E2526796%2EgJ8IBz)**
