Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes to tell you about myself, my upbringing, and my work in Congress.

I was raised in West Point, Georgia, where my family roots go several generations deep. Here, I learned the core values that I still uphold to this day, thanks to my mother and father.

My parents taught me to work hard not only for myself but for others. They instilled that we should all work for the greater good so that the next generation has a bright future ahead to continue our progress.

After graduating high school, I attended the University of Georgia (Go Dawgs!), then gained early acceptance to the Medical College of Georgia and received my degree in dental medicine. From here, I moved back to my hometown to open a family practice.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=2745a0c39cf749c2b818f789ef02dfc1&_e=xsIqC-JSykygr6xxFo1JgdOOwrntI7KRzGxkMvhh4LTNsB-ATKhPWb0LERbC_ihOHVuFYwmDPYCypoH5LvTKcpz_xP6OG34Ra2dhVyMtbzkRsqZZ2lgF2mYTi3WhTFyOhXKJeh7D1SE7zE1JaLWS3f_x3JLoGcYn_-Lk4Dymk500W3Nqxok5dVU9cqjzAwN9AwdhIrXR_rD_aB4nDtM2uaeJgH47HREmcE8rIP2mLTf16BIeXfcQf441h4ogmvqEJ1sL9Amvz1g71cjkrh9w-YZMqPX2qKvnCfTwVltgtPFHCijkHxjw9VSonx01fTKot4yTkq6h8C50_3uG3U7e6zlz4iAj6jgtHTuOW93urKuMdvmKPTr-vpgHL9XLNru75MdIrr3uYG0M2O4zsqo3_hMi9YsDzbq7oc9GXcTEEd8%3D)
**_This is when I saw the community that I absolutely loved heading towards a downfall._**

You see, after the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), we saw thousands upon thousands of jobs disappear, and the younger generation packed up their things and left.

I had reached the point where I would either have to move or stay and fight for my community. In 2008, I was elected Mayor and was able to recruit the Kia Motors manufacturing facility. This created 16,000 new advanced manufacturing jobs and soon turned into a 1.3-billion-dollar industrial project. **This not only revitalized our community but an entire region in West Georgia.**

**The biggest takeaway from being a small-town mayor is that it’s about balancing a budget and to be a good steward of those dollars, and that is what’s missing under the current federal government.**

My race for Congress in 2016 was so I could continue to serve the great people of this district, and I remember the work my community accomplished together to bring our small town’s economy back to life.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=2745a0c39cf749c2b818f789ef02dfc1&_e=xsIqC-JSykygr6xxFo1JgdOOwrntI7KRzGxkMvhh4LTNsB-ATKhPWb0LERbC_ihOHVuFYwmDPYCypoH5LvTKcpz_xP6OG34Ra2dhVyMtbzkRsqZZ2lgF2mYTi3WhTFyOhXKJeh7D1SE7zE1JaLWS3f_x3JLoGcYn_-Lk4Dymk500W3Nqxok5dVU9cqjzAwN9AwdhIrXR_rD_aB4nDtM2uaeJgH47HREmcE8rIP2mLTf16BIeXfcQf441h4ogmvqEJ1sL9Amvz1g71cjkrh9w-VShcgOie1XAXXIWyd3-A5b5-QNSRTTAPMECNhqmlHmnkL26ty9LGaOC-zjctnEcy99EalEBp7IxkSGhMc1-Z2MHv3Y8mVCALXtyDpSllms_OnyGEDezmqQOJSjXVJgWEUEbLHymuoGrAyX4fqwG8NI%3D)
Today in the House, along with representing the 3rd District of Georgia, I serve as the House Republican Chief Deputy Whip and a member of the Ways and Means Committee. Both positions allow me to help my fellow colleagues and truly look at the government’s budget as a whole.

**I am proud of the work I have accomplished during my time in Congress, but there is so much more to be done.**
Job creation couldn’t be more important to me, but so is removing the barriers that prevent those in poverty from moving into the middle class. Under current leadership, fellow Americans are being forced out due to high taxes, inflation, and jobs being sent overseas.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=2745a0c39cf749c2b818f789ef02dfc1&_e=xsIqC-JSykygr6xxFo1JgdOOwrntI7KRzGxkMvhh4LTNsB-ATKhPWb0LERbC_ihOHVuFYwmDPYCypoH5LvTKcpz_xP6OG34Ra2dhVyMtbzkRsqZZ2lgF2mYTi3WhTFyOhXKJeh7D1SE7zE1JaLWS3f_x3JLoGcYn_-Lk4Dymk500W3Nqxok5dVU9cqjzAwN9AwdhIrXR_rD_aB4nDtM2uaeJgH47HREmcE8rIP2mLTf16BIeXfcQf441h4ogmvqEJ1sL9Amvz1g71cjkrh9w-XQ81kztEbQb4BEsrRIyAOcNapGPeU88mfkvZqeWm-UieL_60E3fTz53FQbidUoHJbCOmlOpVFWP803ib4bBiS7isOuX2PhMF5EavJ7HeCBpTAdsjk1l_Ek-2bC8oPF6kyd87kV_H3juZ-gcoNbKfXc%3D)

**We have a chance to change our nation's direction, and it isn’t by pushing more reckless spending like the current administration is doing.**
It’s time for our government to buckle down and start working for the people. That means bringing jobs back to our land, finding solutions to combat record-high inflation, and ensuring that our middle class is stronger than ever.

[**But with Pelosi running amok in the House to push her radical agenda and dangerous ideologies, reinstating conservative, fiscally responsible leadership has never been more important. That is why I hope you will join me today so I can continue the good work our country needs.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=2745a0c39cf749c2b818f789ef02dfc1&_e=xsIqC-JSykygr6xxFo1JgdOOwrntI7KRzGxkMvhh4LTNsB-ATKhPWb0LERbC_ihOHVuFYwmDPYCypoH5LvTKcpz_xP6OG34Ra2dhVyMtbzkRsqZZ2lgF2mYTi3WhTFyOhXKJeh7D1SE7zE1JaLWS3f_x3JLoGcYn_-Lk4Dymk500W3Nqxok5dVU9cqjzAwN9AwdhIrXR_rD_aB4nDtM2uaeJgH47HREmcE8rIP2mLTf16BIeXfcQf441h4ogmvqEJ1sL9Amvz1g71cjkrh9w-d5b1UWmDa8276NtMcV2L3dpRzEduOYdIDN1dNDXSXPa1Vnp0WAeynFEQORcku3r-oCxPIjDmwo16KhInNC6rMKLo1GW96kMepP4ZTtWkD65_nilI31TU12D2AwpEHtjQeGAG-bQFMZQBjkEc9BBhMo%3D)

Tiffany Smiley

body:
Flipping Ohio means Democrats could expand our Senate majority, prevent Republicans from passing a nationwide abortion ban, and keep MAGA Republicans out of the Senate. | |
---
Derek -- Friday is the final end-of-quarter deadline ahead of this year’s elections. Here’s why I need you to split a $10 donation to help flip states like Ohio blue:
* Mitch McConnell’s super PAC is already dumping tens of millions of dollars into Ohio to defeat me. We expect millions more to flood into Ohio before Election Day.
* Some polls are showing that this race is statistically tied, so it will be a fight until the very end.

body:
We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. | | | [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d868e43a1fca4467af98e86631871671&_e=M6TSCoe44Y3qO5mKjByDtc1C6HuhwCOZoMObvTD0OY5CA9zzxOnSNdaizZl7BiXpgrh5SL1sbp48xJZc_btLqnGYUpu7Jif5PXDQrEUbEt0i5Gi0pUsAhUoQN4VWtBhyIJLVHZEx-i7cp5MLxhIORLtkSTrAmMdJGl1UBA_qJhgWrdajul-AMo2viStsWyCAB5bvj4QaYqNVEzE44ZUT-EBPh-SaIQBkwjJ3QQ9dRpU%3D)
---
|
---
Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We're a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can't abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We 've been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming -- which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d868e43a1fca4467af98e86631871671&_e=M6TSCoe44Y3qO5mKjByDtc1C6HuhwCOZoMObvTD0OY5CA9zzxOnSNdaizZl7BiXpgrh5SL1sbp48xJZc_btLqnMmGGYs9CFrvc4-LSd3RNQyT7tYCclSasCqjWFCNpLjsOp4fI_kc3NhCkj17PX8MXmbYsL6IFXelUhdSu-GWAd6LII6JWJfTBIPP3fUvJvq8pHHvE1JtKeP4kBuI_EFLWUdyY6flPIS_Q0aR-MMtQk%3D)
---
[**Become a Subscriber Today >>**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d868e43a1fca4467af98e86631871671&_e=M6TSCoe44Y3qO5mKjByDtc1C6HuhwCOZoMObvTD0OY5CA9zzxOnSNdaizZl7BiXpgrh5SL1sbp48xJZc_btLqjnAOSUeITsWNZhqpYRRs3rGBOoJu3gL2YJnFfD2gE0rxvn2u9J1NVM_4L2q-_StcRp4EzqUPxLJH_7Ckust2BgO1WihhgscGGTegpGd_2T5rTkK3ihyQLF2QQSQRhcQCRHwAyPXibM-JowS_sn8ZIs%3D)
---

Dear Derek,
Adam wanted me to reach out to you because the challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. Historic attacks on the right to vote, on a woman’s right to choose, and on our children’s right to be free of gun violence will either destroy this great state or will be overcome by the resolve and power of the people of Texas.
Greg Abbott has prioritized extreme fringe policies instead of expanding health care, fixing the grid, or improving public education. He signed the nation’s most extreme abortion bill into law with no exception for rape or incest. And he refuses to lift a finger to reduce gun violence after six major mass shootings have occurred on his watch.
Despite all of that — or maybe because of all of that — Texans are standing up to be counted in the fight for a far better Texas. It’s inspiring how the people of this great state are choosing to meet the moment. Already, 90,000 volunteers have signed up for voter contact shifts to reach millions of voters wherever they are across Texas. And we have taken this campaign to literally every part of the state — showing up for everyone and writing no one off.
But we face a real challenge in overcoming the millions of dollars that Greg Abbott was able to raise from special interests before we ever entered the race. He’ll use that to lie to voters about my record and try to keep them from turning out. And there’s a chance he’ll succeed if we don’t have the resources to fight back.
**[So I need your help, Derek, to make sure we can hire more organizers, open new field offices, run ads, and ultimately reach all of the voters who will decide this election. body:

#
Peter,
Before I ask you to make a contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin, I would like to take a moment to say why it's so important that we help him defeat Ron Johnson and expand the Senate majority.
Let me be very clear:
Ron Johnson is a self-serving multi-millionaire who voted to give huge tax breaks to himself and his billionaire donors. How pathetic is that?
Mandela Barnes can defeat him – but only if we're all in this together.

#

We’re writing with an important request, but first, here’s a brief state of the race:
**Earlier this month:** McConnell’s Senate Leadership Fund upped their ad buy to over $28,000,000. North Carolina was one of an extremely small number of races where they doubled down.
**Last Friday:** Donald Trump flew in to share the stage with Ted Budd again. They rallied their far-right base — pushing false, debunked attacks against Cheri and even calling her a “Marxist radical.”
**Now:** Our campaign is facing our biggest test EVER. The final quarterly FEC deadline is Friday.
We have Republicans on defense here, and we need to keep the pressure on. Our only chance is if we raise the resources now by reaching our biggest goal ever before we close the books on the FEC deadline.

MLG shutdown our schools longer than just about every state in the nation. It didn’t work to stop COVID, as New Mexico has the 6th highest COVID death rate in the country. When was the last time you heard from the media that our COVID death rate is higher than states that allowed in-person learning? When have you ever heard MLG asked about it by a reporter? It doesn’t happen. Unfortunately, now our kids are paying the price for all the lost learning. **In New Mexico, just 1 in 3 students read at grade level, and even fewer students are performing at grade level in math.****When the media reported these terrible test results, they didn’t even ask the governor about it. In fact, the**** _Albuquerque Journal_****didn’t even mention her in the article. Hard to believe, but it’s true. ** That’s why it’s up to us to hold her accountable. Education is foundational to the well-being and success of our state. It’s the key to allowing children to live the American Dream.

Why, then, is our governor funneling tax dollars to free tuition for illegal immigrants instead of taking decisive and immediate action to help our kids catch up? As New Mexico’s next governor, I’ll get to work **from day one** to put my plan in motion. 🤝 **We will** **make up for lost time** after MLG’s disastrous and failed lockdowns**** by giving a $1,500 stipend over the next three years to every low-income child’s family in the first through third grades to purchase outside-of-the-classroom academic support. 💲 **We will keep education dollars in the classroom.** From 2007 to 2019, spending on general and central office administration increased by 55% while instructional and student support grew by just 20%. Nearly 70% of the school districts have grown their central office administrative spending faster than their classroom spending. **🔬****We will protect parents’ rights to engage in their child’s education.** It’s time to get politics out of the classroom and prioritize improving our failures. Parents deserve to know where their child’s academic performance stands and to have the flexibility to whatever public school best meets their needs, not the state government’s needs. And, Peter, **that’s only just the beginning.** I can’t wait to seize this opportunity before us to bring categorical, lasting change to our schools, and I’m excited to have your support in our fight. Mark Ronchetti

| Dear Peter,

Farming is the backbone of our district and our country. I will always celebrate the American farmer, their work ethic, and the quality products they bring into our homes.

However, it’s hard for the American farmer to celebrate these days, as they’re facing more challenges than ever. From trade and market access, rising input costs, and supply chain issues, to concerns over rural broadband and aging transportation infrastructure, today’s farmers need an advocate in Washington who will address their concerns and work to make their jobs easier.

[That's why I am reaching out today to build my agriculture coalition; comprised of farmers, agribusiness leaders, and industry experts.](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=9ba5fc6ccb&e=2fa613cb76) I need a strong coalition behind me who will stand up against the record high inflation under the Biden Administration (that Nikki Budzinski was a part of until just a year ago).

I am committed to reducing inflation, lowering the cost of living, building our workforce, and putting our families first.

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) had claimed the name and location of the testing facilities were protected by the confidential commercial information exemption of the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA). == ---|--- | | | | = | = The record-breaking number—more than 2 million and counting—of illegal immigrants that have entered the U.S. through Mexico this year has inevitably received considerable media attention lately, but there is another alarming figure that deserves coverage. Federal immigration courts have closed a “historical record” 375,000 cases in the first 11 months of fiscal year 2022, which ends in September, thanks to Biden administration policies largely dictated by leftist open border groups. = ---|--- | | | | == | == We now have another “Open Letter” – claiming America is “an exceptionally challenging civil-military environment” — signed by 8 former U.S. defense secretaries and 5 former chairmen of the joint chiefs of staff. The letter is published by “War on the Rocks” a website advertising itself as “National Security. For insiders. By insiders.” The September 6, 2022 commentary is titled, “To Support And Defend: Principles Of Civilian Control And Best Practices Of Civil-Military Relations.” == ---|--- | | | | | Judicial Watch announced recently that it received records from the California Highway Patrol (CHP) Public Records Unit that include 44 photos and five hours of audio/video footage depicting the misconduct and arrest of Paul Pelosi, husband to Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi. The material shows Mr. Pelosi invoked his wife’s name and shared his police charity membership during the arrest. ---|--- | | | = Breitbart Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton questioned Good Information Foundation’s motives and lack of transparency on Tuesday’s edition of SiriusXM’s Breitbart News Daily with host Alex Marlow, after the tax-exempt organization was accused of allegedly trying to pay an attorney to spread false information about former President Trump and “Trump Republicans” on social media. = == Newsmax Judicial Watch has filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) suit against the Department of Homeland Security seeking Secret Service records about an investigation into the disappearance of a firearm belonging to Hunter Biden. == = Newsmax President Joe Biden is minimizing the COVID pandemic for political purposes by saying it’s over, but wants to keep the emergency declaration alive to keep his spending push open, “also to help himself with the election,” Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton told Newsmax on Sunday. “This is a case where the president wanted to have his cake and eat it too,” but that also gives people who challenge some of his moves, including student loan forgiveness, a stronger argument, Fitton told Newsmax’s “Wake Up America.” = = = | CLIPS = | = | | == | | | Keep our investigators on the job uncovering the truth: | == | | | | ---|---|--- = = = Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800, Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 (C)2017-2022, All Rights Reserved = |

body:
Dear Friends,

With just 6 weeks to go before November 8th, we need to make every moment count to ensure a great Democratic victory in the Midterm Elections. That’s why for our Grassroots Volunteer Update this week, it is my great pleasure to invite you to join me and my amazing colleague, Congresswoman Joyce Beatty of Ohio.

Madam Chair Joyce Beatty, a lifelong advocate for justice and defender of our personal freedoms and democracy, leads the Congressional Black Caucus with moral clarity and a clarion voice that challenge our national conscience to fight for and live up to our ideals.

In the Congress, Rep. Beatty works to ensure that policy is not shaped in a vacuum but by informed, diverse perspectives. She serves on the House Committee on Financial Services and Chairs its Subcommittee on Diversity and Inclusion. Chair Beatty also serves on Financial Services subcommittees on Housing, Community Development, and Insurance. She is on a mission to end disparities in health, education, and access to capital in order to bring opportunity and health and financial security in reach for everyone.

Join our conversation! We’re talking about the kitchen table concerns of working families and our fight to defend our freedoms, our voting rights and our Democracy. The stakes could not be higher – and we need YOU.

Register to join us tomorrow night – Tuesday September 27 at 6PM PT / 9PM ET:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_cTMT_GEkTJ-jliFNhaaqdw

Thank you for your support of our House Democrats and for that you are doing every day to ensure that we elect Democratic Majorities in the House and Senate on November 8th. The hard work of our VIPS – you, our volunteers in politics and policy – will fuel our wins For The People.

NANCY
Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7636?t=1016&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ][IMG]

The Senate is scheduled to vote on a must-pass bill that attached
Manchin’s Dirty Deal on Tuesday — but our pressure campaign is working!

Our Revolution launched this fight early, mobilizing thousands of calls to
members of Congress, and now more and more are coming out to oppose the
deal.

The next few days are critical. We need to be as loud as possible and
that’s why we’re taking the fight to Capitol Hill on Tuesday!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7636?t=1017&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ][IMG]

Our Revolution and our coalition will Rally Against the Dirty Deal on
Capitol Hill, starting at 9 am Tuesday, Sept. 27th. Join us in person or
tune in to our LIVE broadcast!

Bill McKibben and representatives of frontline communities in West
Virginia and Virginia will speak against Joe Manchin's Dirty Deal and how
we can STOP it!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7638?t=1018&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]ATTEND THE RALLY

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7636?t=1019&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ][IMG]

Bernie railed against the dirty deal on the Senate floor weeks ago, and US
Rep. Ro Khanna joined our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7611?t=1020&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]Town Hall last week, standing with Bernie as
a firm no-vote on any continuing resolution with this deal attached.

With a budget deadline looming, more than 80 US House Reps have signed
onto a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7584?t=1021&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]letter led by Rep. Raul Grijalva — and now, Sen. Jeff Merkley
is leading a similar [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7644?t=1022&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]letter.

So far, Sens. Tammy Duckworth, Cory Booker, Elizabeth Warren, Chris Van
Hollen, Benjamin Cardin, and of course Bernie, signed to oppose attaching
the Dirty Deal to the must-pass bill.

Manchin made the cringe claim that he’s a victim of “revenge politics,”
Bernie responded: “Defeating the Big Oil side deal is not about revenge,”
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7640?t=1023&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]Common Dreams reported.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7641?t=1024&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]Tell your Senator to vote NO on Tuesday and do everything they can to
STOP this dirty deal.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7636?t=1025&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ][IMG]

Manchin’s dirty deal is a wishlist written by fossil fuel lobbyists that
would sacrifice frontline communities and expedite fossil fuel projects —
and effectively cancel out the climate steps Democrats are celebrating in
the Inflation Reduction Act!

“The IRA was the compromise, and we need more people to say what Bernie
Sanders and I are saying, which is we’re going to vote no if push comes to
shove on this,” [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7642?t=1026&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]Common Dreams quoted Ro Khanna from our town hall.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7585?t=1027&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]Tell your Rep to publicly state they’ll only vote for a continuing
resolution without the poison pill of Manchin’s dirty deal attached.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7636?t=1028&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ][IMG]

We can’t let Manchin hold us hostage.

As Greenpeace USA’s Tefere Gebre reminded us in our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7611?t=1029&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]Town Hall:
“Remember, Joe Manchin promised to vote for Build Back Better and he
walked away from that deal. We don’t owe Manchin anything.”

Let’s keep escalating the pressure on our representatives to stand with
climate and stand with frontline communities — and reject this Dirty Deal!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7585?t=1030&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ]CALL YOUR HOUSE REP

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7636?t=1031&akid=3433%2E5885482%2E8kf7M4 ][IMG]

CLIMATE ACTION STRIKE

On Friday, Our Revolution NJ took part in a Global Climate Strike,
rallying on Rutgers Campus and marching to US Rep. Frank Pallone’s office
to call on him to oppose Manchin’s dirty deal.

Our Revolution Organizing Coordinator Anna-Marty Visky caught up with
Pallone on the street — and he committed to opposing the Dirty Deal!

Our Revolution NJ is part of the Empower NJ climate coalition that met on
the issue with the staff of Sen. Cory Booker — who has since signed onto
Merkley’s letter opposing the deal.

We’re also ramping up pressure on Sen. Bob Menendez and US Rep. Andy Kim
in NJ.

Ellison as Attorney General!

A Board Member of Our Revolution, he has worked for decades to advance
democratic and criminal-justice reform and to fight corporate monopolies.

During the pandemic, Keith worked to combat price gouging and
profiteering, including on prescription drugs. He also led the team that
convicted former Minneapolis police officer Derek Chauvin for the murder
of George Floyd.

a tough race this year. Like most progressives, he’s the target of the
billionaire and rightwing smear machine.

body:
The 13th Annual Pride Event in Redding.... | |
---
Happy Friday, friend.

Last weekend I attended Redding's 13th Annual Pride Event. It was great seeing people of different gender and sexual orientations supporting each other. That's what MY America is all about. About 800 people attended the Saturday night drag show. That's amazing - especially for Redding. Team,
Today, we want to take a bit of a deep dive into one of the most important parts of a campaign: the field program.
Field teams are responsible for the vast majority of a campaign’s direct contact with voters. That can include hosting events, knocking on doors, calling and texting voters, and even helping folks register to vote. It’s a massive undertaking that takes countless hours and the help of some incredible volunteers. With just 43 days until the election, Team Slotkin’s field effort is firing on all cylinders in every community across Michigan’s 7th district. Check out these stats:
secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220926&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220926&amount=28]
Here on Team Slotkin, we’ve not only made it a priority to build a strong in-house field team, but also to build new volunteer networks in the new 7th district. We’ve also intentionally focused on building a student organizer program at Michigan State University with the goal of registering as many new voters as we possibly can.
Elissa’s opponent, on the other hand, is taking a different approach. Right now, Americans for Prosperity, a conservative super PAC, is paying people to knock doors in support of Elissa’s opponent. If this strategy sounds familiar it’s because it’s the same approach he’s using for TV and digital advertising – let the outside super PACs do the talking for him.
Relying on outside groups or corporate interests rather than building in-house programs has been a theme among Michigan Republicans this year. In the spring, half of the Republican gubernatorial candidates were eliminated from running in the primary after failing to submit enough valid signatures to get on the ballot. Many had submitted fraudulent signatures, because they had hired a company to collect signatures for them, rather than hiring a robust field team and training volunteers.
At the end of the day, a strong field team means a strong campaign. As we continue to build our outreach program ahead of Election Day, we’d be grateful if you’d chip in to help get us over the finish line, especially with our September 30th end-of-quarter deadline coming up. Our aligned mission is simple: help the families of Texans by putting them and their needs first and foremost. Rep. Escobar has done that time and time again while in office.
We are both leaders ingrained in our communities and we grew up in the places we are ready to serve. From El Paso and McAllen, it’s all the Rio Grande Valley that we love and call home.
And the struggles that Rep. Escobar and I see affecting our neighbors, friends, and family are the same.
